title.sub_en: Garden flame weeder for horticultural use

works.description: 本產品希望透過改良噴槍結構，設計出適用於園藝等需要精細控制的火焰除草工具，以有效去除雜草，同時減少土壤污染、維持土壤健康，促進環境永續發展。
works.longDescription: 園藝是一項精細且講究技巧的活動，相較於一般農業，更需要對工具進行精確操作。近年來，隨著環保意識提升，火焰除草因其高效無化學殘留的優勢，在世界各地廣泛應用於大面積農地。現有的噴火槍多為大範圍使用，難以滿足園藝作業的精細需求。本產品透過改良噴火槍的結構設計，提高火焰的精確度，是適用於園藝的火焰除草工具。
works.english: This product enhances the design of a spray gun with a flame-weeding tool tailored for gardening applications that need precise control. It effectively removes weeds, reduces soil pollution, maintains soil health, and promotes environmental sustainability.
works.english_detail: Gardening requires precision, and current flame-weeding tools are too large for detailed tasks. This product improves the flame gun design, enhancing flame accuracy and making it perfect for fine control in gardening applications. It ensures efficiency without compromising precision.

works.description: EasySmile 專為牙醫外出診療提供支援，可用於完成洗牙、看診、拔牙等基礎牙科診療。提升不同環境下的牙科醫療服務品質，讓更多人獲得適切的口腔照護。
works.longDescription: 牙科醫療長期被忽視，許多人在牙痛嚴重時才就診，忽略日常保健的重要性。EasySmile 正是為解決這一問題而設計的牙科診療工具，專為牙醫外出診療提供支援。適用於偏遠地區、安養院、學校及居家診療。透過提供便捷且高品質的牙科醫療服務，縮小醫療落差，提升各年齡層與不同場域的口腔健康，讓牙齒保健更加普及。
works.english: EasySmile is designed to support dentists during mobile consultations, enabling essential dental treatments such as cleanings, check-ups, and extractions. It enhances the quality of dental care in various environments, ensuring more people receive proper oral healthcare.
works.english_detail: Dental care is often neglected, with many seeking treatment only when pain is severe.EasySmile addresses this by providing mobile dental consultations, making it ideal for remote areas, nursing homes, schools, and home care. This convenient service enhances oral health for all age groups and environments.
